en.name: Victor III
en.summary: A reluctant successor to Gregory VII, previously the great abbot of Monte Cassino, whose brief reign continued the investiture struggle.
en.body: Victor III, born Desiderius, had built Monte Cassino into one of medieval Europe's great centers of learning and art before his election, which he initially resisted amid continued conflict with the imperially backed antipope Clement III occupying Rome. His short reign upheld Gregory VII's reform program, including renewed prohibition of lay investiture, before his death less than eighteen months into office.
